name: Brief
tagline: Coaches a first-time builder through writing their first bot brief
description: The hardest part of making a bot is describing what you want it to do. This one sits with a beginner, asks the questions that surface the real job, and produces a single clear brief they can then take away and use to create the bot themselves.
author: anandVragav
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
